# Intergrax — Agent OS / Harness AI

**Positioning:** Harness AI & Agent OS — agents decide domain steps (`on_next_step` → `StepOutcome`); HarnessKernel executes policy/trace/state; NexusLoop orchestrates multi-agent Tasks; Tier-3 applications supply identity, profiles, and production gates. The Harness is the product; agents are replaceable. Canon: docs/architecture/AGENT_CONTRACTS_AND_ASSEMBLY.md §13–§40 · ADR-AGENT-001..003.

**Hub (sole docs/ root file):** docs/intergrax_runtime_architecture.md

**Guides (strategy, ideal, audit):** docs/guides/
**System invariants (P2-ARCH-01):** docs/guides/SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.md — cross-domain “never violate” index before domain pairs
**Layer completion:** docs/guides/LAYER_COMPLETION_MODE.md — full domain layer closeout (audit → maturity)
